preconditions: Z8 cross-cohort H~Q structure analysis complete (per-cohort fits only); if the discovery-side correlation sign is bootstrap-unstable, all moderation narrative is struck from this protocol before freezing
Z2-upgraded noise floor complete: 3 checkpoints x 5 generation seeds + 1-2 same-seed retraining segments; sigma_e recorded below
freeze_procedure.freeze_action: sha256sum protocol.json analysis_plan sections > protocol.sha256; commit timestamp must precede the first line of any stage-1 training log
freeze_procedure.note: This file is a DRAFT. No experiment may start against it. Amendments before freeze are unrestricted; after freeze, only outcome-blind amendments with authorization records (same standard as q256_fresh_crossed_switch_n12_matpool_v1).

design.name: two-arm crossed-history continuation, n=24
design.rationale_data: fresh n=11: corr(C1,C2)=0.965 between the two continuation contrasts, so the second continuation is nearly redundant for the history effect; at equal budget (~96 RE) two-arm n=24 gives planned-effect power 0.96 vs 0.82 for four-arm n=16, assurance ~0.83 vs ~0.72. Computed from published H_C_I_Q_G_per_seed.csv (design-planning use of unblinded data; no new inference).

arms_per_seed.stage1: A history (g=1.0) and B history (g=1.1), 0 -> 512 kimg, full state saved at 512
arms_per_seed.stage1b: both histories continue under current-A, 512 -> 1024 kimg (AA and BA; AA passes through the same switch-resume machinery as BA, no-op verified by parity gate)

design.training_commit_semantics: identical to protocol q256_fresh_crossed_switch_n12_matpool_v1 (batch=128, batch_gpu=16, q=256, canonical CIFAR-10 SHA256 08c9ed1b2b1c523268dc0f05a0569dd654209aea46197e3f56ec149dd714f372)
design.evaluator: frozen evaluator commit d6aba02fb88e9db0993623895eb2228ed717d810, FP32, FID50k NFE1 primary; blind sealed evaluation matrix identical in mechanism to the n=11 protocol

primary_endpoint.test: one-sided paired t-test on mean(H_A), H1: E[H_A] < 0, alpha = 0.05

planning_assumptions.sd_source: fresh n=11 SD(H_A); to be replaced by noise-floor-informed value if Z2-upgrade shows material evaluation-noise share
planning_assumptions.assurance_at_fresh_posterior: approximately 0.83 (Bayesian predictive power given fresh n=11 posterior)
planning_assumptions.honesty_clause: This design has 80% power only for effects >= 0.058; the fresh point estimate is -0.078 and its 95% CI includes zero. A null or inconclusive outcome is a live possibility and its reporting is prespecified below.

gatekeeping_chain.rule: fixed-sequence; each step tested at full alpha only if the previous step rejects

step2.name: dose trend
step2.design: nested arm: g=1.2 history (0->512) + current-A continuation (512->1024) on preselected seeds [51..58]; model H_{s,g} = b0 + b1*(g-1.0) + u_s + eps with seed random intercept over g in {1.0 (AA control), 1.1, 1.2}; g=1.1 data from THIS cohort only (no reuse of unblinded n=11 results in the trend test)
step2.test: two-sided alpha = 0.05 on b1 (two-sided because the discovery/fresh corr(H,Q) signs conflict; no directional prior is defensible)
step2.claim_level: spacing-schedule dose at the policy level; channel attribution (target vs weight) is explicitly out of scope and deferred to the archived stage-2 regime experiment

step3_optional_module.name: horizon extension
step3_optional_module.design: extend AA/BA of all n=24 seeds (or, if budget-bound, the preregistered first 12 by seed number) from 1024 to 2048 kimg; endpoint H_A@2048
step3_optional_module.test: one-sided alpha = 0.05, only if steps 1 and 2 both reject
step3_optional_module.activation: include/exclude decided at freeze time by budget; if excluded, it may be preregistered later as a same-cohort extension BEFORE any 2048 evaluation exists
step3_optional_module.framing_rule: decay of the effect at 2048 is reported as persistence-timescale characterization, not as refutation; prewritten reading: decay supports the mid-training-misranking thesis (rankings drift on this timescale)

interim_analysis.type: binding futility-only; zero alpha spend (no efficacy stopping)
interim_analysis.timing: after seeds [51..62] (first 12 by preassigned seed number, NOT by completion order) complete both arms and their 1024 evaluations under seal
interim_analysis.mechanism: committed script interim_futility.py (SHA256 recorded in protocol.sha256) emits a single token {CONTINUE, STOP-FUTILITY}; sealed numerical log written to evidence/interim_sealed/, decoded only at final database lock; no effect estimate, sign, or magnitude disclosed to any author before final lock
interim_analysis.stop_rule: STOP-FUTILITY iff observed mean(H_A,12) > 0 OR conditional power at design effect -0.076 < 0.20
interim_analysis.blinded_sd_reestimation: pooled (sign-free) SD computed at interim; if SD > 0.15, n extends to the preset cap of 28 using replacement-pool-style additional seeds [83..86]; this uses no effect-direction information and does not affect alpha

missing_data.termination_criterion: identical to n=11 protocol: second non-finite loss event in any arm, validator-enforced
missing_data.primary_population: replaced cohort n=24: a terminated seed is replaced by the next seed in the ordered replacement pool, decided before any 1024-kimg evaluation of that seed is decoded; at most 4 replacements
missing_data.secondary_instability_endpoint: count of B-history-arm terminations, reported with arm identity (instability is itself carryover-relevant evidence)
sensitivity_analyses: all-started-seeds tipping-point: terminated seeds imputed at H_A = +/- 2*SD, report whether the primary conclusion flips
complete-case (the n=11 protocol's primary, here demoted to sensitivity)

transplant.design: at the 512 switch: 2x2 {A-history, B-history} x {RAdam-moments reset, no reset} on 3 preselected seeds (2 largest-|H| candidates from planning data + 1 randomly drawn, rationale recorded), continuation-A to 1024; plus EMA-swap and params-swap variants each with a sham arm (self-transplant through the same machinery) that must pass verify_parity.py no-op standard or the module is void
transplant.go_no_go: EMA-swap arm runs only if analytic EMA residual weight w = 2^(-512/t_half) >= 0.05 (G0-c)
transplant.status: exploratory; no hypothesis test; cannot appear in the abstract as evidence; manipulation check = first-8-kimg loss shift vs pre-switch 32-kimg mean, reported not inferred

exploratory_modules.scorecard: before any exploratory module runs, each named hypothesis (EMA inertia / moments channel / dose monotonicity / persistence) records its predicted sign per module in evidence/scorecard.json; post-hoc reporting is restricted to hit/miss against this table

descriptive_analyses.persistence_regression: H_A_s = alpha + rho * Q_s + eps with errors-in-variables correction rho_c = S_HQ / (S_QQ - 2*sigma_e^2) using sigma_e from the Z2-upgraded noise floor; alpha_c = mean(H_A) - rho_c * mean(Q); BCa bootstrap CIs; estimation only, no test
descriptive_analyses.moderation_clause: No inferential claim about H-Q moderation will be made at any n achievable in this project. All Q-segment displays use sample quantiles, not preregistered thresholds.
descriptive_analyses.cross_cohort_synthesis: descriptive random-effects synthesis of the two preregistered cohorts (n=11, n=24) may be displayed, labeled 'descriptive synthesis, not a hypothesis test'; the no-merged-single-test rule stands

reporting_rules.verdict_categories: same five frozen categories as the n=11 protocol (strong success / weak directional replication / informative practical null / opposite-direction falsification / inconclusive), applied to H_A with the equivalence band +/- log(1.03)
wording: sign counts always accompanied by magnitudes
reversal statements always carry eligibility definition (Q threshold), frequency, and magnitude
the words 'magnitude bracket' are banned; n<6 exploratory outputs report per-seed point values only, with the preregistered sentence 'no interval or directional statement is made'
any sign-flip/permutation p-value is named in full ('exact permutation test on the mean under sign flips') with a code pointer and the 'not a decision input' qualifier where applicable

budget_double_ledger.evaluation_jobs: primary minimal set 24x4 + interim seal + dose + transplant + noise-floor ~ 250-320 jobs
budget_double_ledger.a100_hours_all_in: ~400-500 (vs fresh n=11 actual ~253); 5% rerun margin included per measured failure rate

target_venues: ICML 2027 (late-January deadline) or TMLR; ICLR 2028 explicitly rejected as calendar opportunity cost
